Langdon Alley (printed 'Langdon' / 'Langdon Al.') edges are irregular (10-15 ft); centreline drifts from x 2131 at 7th to 2118 at 6th. '?' is an unnamed ~20 ft street entering 6th from the south (gap in the sheet 121 block outlines, x 2112-2178), about 27 px east of Langdon; name not printed here or on the key map. New Street enters Sycamore from the east (named on this sheet beside the sheet 134 outlines).
